acceptanceCriteria: Finalize is explicit and request-scoped between archive and close.
Strict identity-bound receipt is required by close.
Dirty, unmerged, protected, mismatched, or unknown resources fail closed without deletion.
Visible human Outcome includes marker, evidence, unknowns, decision, and next action.
Existing lifecycle, repository isolation, provider-boundary, and three-language tests remain passing; no global Agent/MCP configuration is modified.
goal: Prevent merged Work Items from being closed while their branch, worktree, or provider resource remains unfinalized, without unsafe automatic deletion.
intent: Make branch/worktree/PR resource finalization a first-class auditable fail-closed Runtime lifecycle boundary so every future Work Item either proves cleanup or records explicit human retention.
outOfScope: Automatic deletion of protected/default branches or resources whose identity cannot be proven.
Editing user-global Agent/MCP configuration or embedding a provider token in the Runtime.
Implementing a single organization approval structure; authority remains policy-defined.
Changing immutable v0.2.17 release truth or rewriting historical Work Item/evidence bytes.
Replacing GitHub hosted branch deletion with an unverified local claim.

scenarioCoverage.expected: finalize verifies merge identity, removes only exact resources, emits a receipt, and close succeeds
scenarioCoverage.scenario: merged PR with clean dedicated worktree and branch
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run a temporary Git repository/provider fixture through archive, finalize-plan, finalize, finalize-verify, and close; assert receipt and postconditions.

scenarioCoverage.expected: no destructive cleanup occurs; Outcome is yellow/red with stable recovery code and Work Item remains recoverable
scenarioCoverage.scenario: dirty, unmerged, protected, mismatched, or provider-unknown resource
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise each negative fixture and assert close is rejected and branch/worktree state is unchanged.

scenarioCoverage.expected: repository-local serialization yields at most one cleanup and repeat requests are idempotent
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run two finalize processes against one Work Item and repeat a completed finalize; assert one receipt and stable no-op results.
